main.label: Glowing floors never reached the borg grid flags
main.explanation: A permanently glowing arena floor is shown to a munchkin-configured Warrior through the production map update. The original map update's Floors branch tested the same condition as the Darkness branch before it and was never taken: no grid anywhere was ever flagged BORG_GLOW, and the flow-toward-light consumer found an empty target list. The corrected branch (restored FEAT_FLOOR condition, glow read from square_islit) flags the glowing floors, walls stay unflagged, and the consumer's list fills.
